title: GenAL: Generative Agent for Adaptive Learning

layout.note: Two stacked tinted regions (Global Thinking Agent on top, Local Teaching Agent below, the lower one starting after the learner column), the learner and the exercise book in a white column on the left, and a framed legend strip along the bottom; a thick black loop arrow frames the right and bottom edges.

lesson: Give each agent its own tinted region titled by role, put the user outside in a white column, and close the loop with one thick return arrow; a framed legend strip then explains every arrow type and tile in one line.
